_comment: Days and times the eBay notifications fire. Times are PST (America/Los_Angeles). Each weekday holds an ARRAY of shifts; each shift has hour, minute, and shift_id (which must match a key in messages.json[weekday]). fire_window_minutes is how long after the scheduled time the bot is still allowed to fire — gives slack for cron-job.org being a few minutes late.
_shifts: Mon-Thu 1 PM: Ruby (day). Fri-Sun 2 PM: Elijah (day). Fri-Sun 8 PM: Apollo (night).
